item.title: Rost Martin RM1F Series: Full-Size Striker-Fired Pistols for Real-World Use
item.description: If you haven’t tried Rost Martin pistols yet, you’re missing out on standout ergonomics and a unique approach to striker-fired pistols. Now, with the introduction of the RM1F and RM1F Tactical, there are even more reasons to see what sets this lineup apart. These full-size 9mm pistols are designed for those who care about ergonomics and performance, whether you’re heading to the range or need a duty pistol you can count on.
